original_test_intent: Measure PCIe eye margin for every required lane on the designated BlueField/ConnectX path with NVQual Test #19 and prove horizontal/vertical margin meets the approved generation-specific limits without link degradation, traffic impact, hang, reboot or new errors.
original_method: Pin the NIC serial/port/BDF and complete root-port/switch/retimer/lane path, negotiated generation/width, exact Test #19 margin method, units, sampling, presets/equalization context and per-lane limits; drain workloads and preserve baseline; collect complete raw lane measurements and synchronized link/AER/health state; stop on first limit or instability and recover without forced reset.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE supplies the licensed module, target path and lane limits; an operator drains dependent traffic, approves link impact and owns recovery.
required_inputs: Licensed pinned NVQual Test #19 eye-margin module and compatible NIC/firmware/driver
NIC serial/port/BDF and complete PCIe path/per-lane identity
Generation/width, preset/equalization context, measurement axes/units/sampling and per-lane thresholds
Traffic drain, link-impact scope, thermal/power/error limits, aborts and vendor recovery
safety_requirements: Dedicated drained SUT and explicit link-impact approval
Trusted authenticated access; preserve logs/counters before testing
Do not force retrain/reset or alter presets outside the pinned method
Stop on link loss/downtraining, AER burst, missing NIC, traffic impact, thermal/power fault, hang/reboot, tool failure or incomplete lane evidence
agent_execution_scope: Validate target/path, tool/config, lane matrix, baseline, thresholds and interlocks
Run only the approved Test #19 module
Collect every lane's raw margin and correlate link/AER/NIC/host/BMC state
Do not infer limits, reset/retrain, retry faults or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Test #19 method, target path/lane matrix, generation and thresholds
Define traffic, link/error and platform acceptance plus recovery
Review complete lane evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It names the right tool family but no executable module/configuration or lane acceptance exists; an aggregate pass result alone cannot prove all lane margins.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only the pinned Test #19 module against the stable-identity target and retain complete raw per-lane horizontal/vertical measurements, configuration, thresholds and correlated link/error evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVQual Test #19, BlueField eye margin, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 5/15-minute allocation remain; missing limits are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PER-LANE BLUEFIELD PCIE EYE MARGIN QUALIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each raw eye measurement and threshold result to NIC, path, lane, generation, preset/equalization context and synchronized link/error health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable target/lane identity, quantitative limits, full artifacts, traffic drain, first-fault stop and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An aggregate pass can hide one marginal or untested lane, wrong generation, wrong NIC/port or a recovered link disturbance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Margin scans can retrain or stress a live link and interrupt dependent traffic; vendor measurement semantics are tool/version specific.

project_override_considerations: An equivalent vendor eye tool may substitute only with approved per-lane units/limits and preserved configuration/raw data. A generic link-health or BER test does not replace eye-margin coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #19 module/license/configuration and authorization
Complete raw per-lane measurements and threshold comparison with timestamps
Abort/recovery or clean final link/traffic state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Test #19 Procedure, Criteria and same-row AI review consistently target BlueField PCIe eye margin. Missing module and limits are readiness inputs, not a competing objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Eye-margin purpose is clear. Licensed tooling, target mapping and lane limits are identifiable prerequisites rather than permanent review blockers.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2139 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00016-V002: approve the pinned NVQual Test #19 eye-margin module, BlueField/ConnectX serial/port/BDF and root-port/switch/retimer/per-lane map, generation/width/preset/equalization context, measurement axes/units/sampling and per-lane limits, traffic-drain/link-impact rules, aborts, and vendor recovery.

review_improvement: Replaces an aggregate pass with complete target-bound per-lane measurements and protects production traffic and failure evidence from unapproved resets or retries.
independent_technical_reasoning: Eye margin is a lane-level analog measurement whose limits depend on generation, measurement method and equalization context. A healthy aggregate link can mask one marginal lane. Therefore every result must bind raw axes/units to the exact physical path and lane, and the first link disturbance must stop the scan before recovery alters the evidence.
